heading: Wednesday, April 29, 2026
topLine: Mistral releases Mistral Medium 3.5 open-weight model.

items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral Medium 3.5 open-weight model
items.summary: Mistral Medium 3.5 is a 128B dense model with a 256k context and vision input that combines instruction-following, reasoning and coding, released as open weights under a modified MIT license and as the default model in Le Chat and Vibe. Mistral reports 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified.
